component.name: EveryGrep
component.summary: Find files and folders by name as you type

description.p: EveryGrep keeps an index of the file and folder names below the folders you choose and lists the names that contain what you type, anywhere in the name, on every key press.

ul.li: A query language with AND, OR, NOT, wildcards, regular expressions, extensions, sizes, dates and file contents
Case and diacritics are ignored by default
The index follows file changes while the program runs and catches up with changes made while it was closed
Folder sizes, removable drives that stay searchable while unplugged, and file lists of disks that are not connected
Duplicate search by contents, name or size
Tabs, filters, bookmarks and search history
Copy, move, rename and trash files, with optional undo
Available in English, Azerbaijani and Turkish

description.p: All data stays on this computer: EveryGrep makes no network connections.
